title.en: Find the geometric mean and use it for growth rates
Find the harmonic mean and use it for speeds
State and verify AM ≥ GM ≥ HM

say.en: A bus goes 60 kilometres to Mysuru at 40 kilometres per hour and returns at 60 kilometres per hour. Most people say the average speed is 50 kilometres per hour. It is actually 48 kilometres per hour. The right average is the harmonic mean. In this lesson: Find the geometric mean and use it for growth rates.
Find the harmonic mean and use it for speeds.
State and verify AM is greater than or equal to GM is greater than or equal to HM.

body.en: The *geometric mean* of n positive values is the nth root of their product. In practice we use logarithms: $\log GM = \sum \log x / n$, so GM = antilog of the mean of the logs. GM is the right average for ratios, percentages and rates of growth (population, production, prices) and is used in index numbers. It cannot be used if any value is zero or negative.
body.kn: n ಧನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧದ n-ನೇ ಮೂಲವೇ ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಾಧ್ಯ. log GM = Σ log x / n. ಅನುಪಾತ, ಶೇಕಡಾ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ದರಗಳಿಗೆ ಇದು ಸೂಕ್ತ; ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ.

say.en: Use logs for many values.
Best for growth rates and ratios.
Take two numbers, 4 and 16. The arithmetic mean is 20 over 2, that is 10.
The geometric mean is the square root of 4 times 16, that is 8.
The harmonic mean is 2 over the sum of reciprocals: 6.4.
So AM is at least GM, which is at least HM. And GM squared, 64, equals AM times HM, 10 times 6.4.
Use HM for the bus: 2 over (1/40 + 1/60) is 48 km per hour.

say.en: A car goes 60 kilometres at one speed and comes back 60 kilometres at another. Three ghost cars drive the whole 120 kilometres at a constant speed equal to the AM, GM and HM of the two speeds. Only the HM car arrives together with yours: for equal distances the right average speed is the harmonic mean.

body.en: The *harmonic mean* is the reciprocal of the mean of the reciprocals: $HM = n / \sum (1/x)$. It is the right average for speeds over equal distances, and prices when equal amounts of money are spent. For positive values $AM \ge GM \ge HM$, with equality only when all values are equal. For two values, $GM^2 = AM \times HM$.
body.kn: ಹರಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಾಧ್ಯ = n / Σ(1/x). ಸಮಾನ ದೂರಗಳ ವೇಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾನ ಹಣ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಬೆಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ. AM ≥ GM ≥ HM; ಎಲ್ಲ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಸಮವಾದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಮಾನತೆ. ಎರಡು ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ GM² = AM × HM.

problem.en: Production rose by 20% in year 1 and 50% in year 2. Find the average annual rate of growth.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Production rose by 20% in year 1 and 50% in year 2. Find the average annual rate of growth.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Production rose by 20 percent in year 1 and 50 percent in year 2. Find the average annual rate of growth.
Growth factors: 1.20 and 1.50.
GM equals the square root of 1.2 times 1.5 equals the square root of 1.8 equals 1.3416.
Average rate equals 1.3416 minus 1 times 100 equals 34.16 percent per year not 35 percent.
So the answer is 34.16 percent per year.

steps.en: Check: time = 1.5 h + 1 h = 2.5 h; 120 km ÷ 2.5 h = 48 km/h.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A bus goes 60 km at 40 km/h and returns at 60 km/h. Find the average speed.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A bus goes 60 kilometres at 40 kilometres per hour and returns at 60 kilometres per hour. Find the average speed.
Equal distances, so use HM.
HM equals 2 divided by (1 over 40 plus 1 over 60) equals 2 divided by (5 over 120) equals 48.
Check: time equals 1.5 hours plus 1 hour equals 2.5 hours; 120 kilometres divided by 2.5 hours equals 48 kilometres per hour.
So the answer is 48 kilometres per hour.
